Its reason, from the public ledger: "Tuesday's daily minimum at the floor: Boston are -453 road favourites at Washington on the runner's ESPN list (about 82% implied); small stake because the edge over the price is thin. It also takes my total wagered past the C$97,000 needed by Nov 28."
